# Yacht Away Now

> Yacht Away Now is a USCG-licensed private yacht charter company in St. Petersburg, Florida, serving Tampa Bay and the Gulf Coast aboard a 52ft Marquis Flybridge and the Sly Fox, all-inclusive from $500 per hour, captained by Josh Wilson, and rated 5.0 on Google.

## About
Yacht Away Now is a private yacht charter company based in St. Petersburg, Florida. The fleet is two yachts: a 52ft Marquis Flybridge carrying up to 13 guests, and Sly Fox, a 3-stateroom / 2-bathroom yacht that sleeps 6. Charter types include sunset cruises, day charters, bachelorette parties, birthday celebrations and multi-day Bahamas trips on Florida's Gulf Coast. Additional yachts are available on request.

## Key Facts
- Location: St. Petersburg, FL (Tampa Bay area)
- Fleet: 2 yachts, the 52ft Marquis Flybridge and Sly Fox
- Vessel: 52ft Marquis Flybridge
- Capacity: Up to 13 guests
- Range: 600 miles (Bahamas capable)
- Decks: 3
- Engine: 1320hp, 30+ knot speed
- Cabin: 1,200 sq ft interior
- Outdoor: 800+ sq ft deck space
- Sly Fox: 3 private staterooms, 2 bathrooms, sleeps 6 overnight, optional chef

## Services
- Sunset Cruises (4-5 hours)
- Day Charters (4+ hours)
- Bachelorette Parties
- Birthday Celebrations
- Corporate Events & Team Retreats
- Overnight Charters
- Multi-Day Bahamas & Florida Keys Trips
- [Private Dinner Cruise St. Petersburg](https://www.yachtawaynow.com/private-dinner-cruise-st-petersburg): Dinner on Deck, a private 4-hour sunset dinner cruise for up to 13, $2,000 weekday / $2,400 weekend plus dinner from a St. Pete restaurant at cost
- [Yacht Rental St. Petersburg](https://www.yachtawaynow.com/yacht-rental-st-petersburg): Captained-only hourly yacht rental, $500/hr Mon-Thu, $600/hr Fri-Sun, 4-hour minimum, no bareboat; direct vs marketplace comparison and 3-step booking
- [Boat Rental With Captain St. Pete](https://www.yachtawaynow.com/boat-rental-with-captain-st-pete): No boating license needed; USCG Master Josh Wilson drives; safety, routes, group sizes, and 4/5/8-hour plans from $2,000
- [Luxury Yacht Charter Tampa Bay](https://www.yachtawaynow.com/luxury-yacht-charter-tampa-bay): All-inclusive Tampa Bay charters from the St. Pete side, covering the Tampa skyline, Skyway, Egmont Key and Shell Key. Both yachts, corporate, birthday and proposal use, Signature Charters

## Pricing
- Weekday (Mon-Thu): $500/hr all-inclusive, 4-hour minimum. 4hr $2,000, 5hr $2,500, 6hr $3,000
- Weekend (Fri-Sun): $600/hr all-inclusive, 4-hour minimum. 4hr $2,400, 5hr $3,000, 6hr $3,600
- Overnight/Bahamas (Marquis): Starting at $9,500+

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a yacht charter in Tampa Bay cost?
Yacht Away Now charters are all-inclusive, with captain, crew and fuel included. Rates are $500/hour on weekdays (Mon-Thu) and $600/hour on weekends (Fri-Sun), with a 4-hour minimum. Four hours is $2,000 on a weekday or $2,400 on a weekend. Overnight and Bahamas charters start at $9,500+.

### How many people can the yacht hold?
The 52ft Marquis Flybridge carries up to 13 guests, across 3 decks, with a 1,200 sq ft interior cabin and 800+ sq ft of outdoor deck space.

### Is a captain included in the charter price?
Yes. A USCG-licensed captain and crew are included in the all-inclusive rate at no extra charge. Captain Josh and the crew handle navigation, anchoring and onboard service.

### Can the yacht travel to the Bahamas?
Yes. The yacht has a 600-mile range and is Bahamas-capable. Multi-day Bahamas and Florida Keys trips start at $9,500+ and are quoted individually based on duration and itinerary.

### Where does the yacht depart from?
Yacht Away Now departs from St. Petersburg, Florida (Tampa Bay area). The exact marina and slip details are confirmed at booking. Mailing address: 38th Way S, St. Petersburg, FL.

### Do you have more than one yacht?
Yes. The 52ft Marquis Flybridge carries up to 13 guests for day and sunset charters. Sly Fox is a 3-stateroom, 2-bathroom yacht that sleeps 6, at $650/hr on weekdays and $750/hr on weekends, with multi-day Gulf Coast itineraries from $5,000 and an optional private chef.

### Can I bring my own food and drinks?
Yes. BYOB and BYO food are permitted on all charters. We provide ice, water and basic supplies. Glass bottles are not permitted onboard (Coast Guard rule) and are transferred to plastic dockside.

### How far in advance should I book?
Booking 4-6 weeks ahead is recommended for weekends, sunset cruises and holidays. Last-minute weekday availability is sometimes possible. Call (727) 609-2248 to check.

### What is the cancellation policy?
If the captain calls off a charter for weather or safety, guests choose any open future date and the booking stays valid for 12 months. For guest-initiated reschedules we work flexibly within available dates. Specific terms are confirmed in the charter agreement at booking.

### Is gratuity included?
No. Crew gratuity is at guest discretion. 10-15% of the charter base is standard, and 100% goes directly to the captain and deckhand.

### What types of events do you charter for?
Sunset cruises, bachelorette and bachelor parties, birthday celebrations, weddings and engagements, anniversaries, corporate events and team retreats, family outings, dolphin and sandbar trips, fireworks viewing, and multi-day Bahamas and Keys trips.
